strings.en:
Shows the conditions for earning this stage's SR Point. Earning it gives +10 PP
(Pilot Points) to all allied Pilots on the map. The conditions may change due
to events. You can't earn the SR Point when retrying a stage after a Game Over.
If under 80% of SR Points have been earned, the difficulty is "NORMAL"; at
80% or more, it is "HARD".
